contracts.label: At-most-once
contracts.detail: Acknowledge before the side effect. Delivery is never repeated by the broker, but a crash can lose accepted work.

contracts.label: At-least-once
contracts.detail: Acknowledge after the side effect. A lost acknowledgement can cause a redelivery, so the consumer must tolerate repeats.

contracts.label: Effectively-once
contracts.detail: Allow at-least-once delivery, then store a stable idempotency record with the business effect so a replay has one observable result.

redrivePolicies.label: Hold the partition
redrivePolicies.detail: Keep retrying the bad message in place. Ordering is preserved, but following work on that partition cannot make progress.

redrivePolicies.label: Retry then dead-letter
redrivePolicies.detail: Use bounded delayed retries, then isolate the poison message for repair and controlled replay.

redrivePolicies.label: Skip after retries
redrivePolicies.detail: Continue the partition by discarding the bad message. This is explicit loss, suitable only when the business can repair from another source.
